_about: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. A target profile that is complete for the shipped base template, so tests can exercise a clean export path. It declares popup ids 4554 and 4646 — the ids the reference site used — which is acceptable HERE because these tests assert tool behaviour against the shipped template on a fictional site. The shipped assets/target-profile.example.json must never do this: it did once, and anyone who copied it and filled in only site_host and preview_slug got a clean validation and two buttons that opened nothing. That was delivery-3 defect D3-B2. Do not copy this file for a real site; copy the example and retarget the buttons with `popup --set`.
